generationMode: built-in ImageGen, one independent call per distinct asset

roles.background: Create a broad, laterally spread, lower-contrast shallow-relief silhouette with two or three overlapping depth shelves, atmospheric edge light, irregular internal gaps, and tapered broken ends. Occupy roughly 45-65% of the canvas while leaving genuine transparent passages and outer margins.
roles.signature: Create one unmistakable hero formation that communicates this biome at a glance: a large asymmetric landmark silhouette, strong central negative-space aperture, broken secondary forms, restrained internal light, and distinctive material construction. Occupy roughly 38-58% of the canvas without becoming a complete cavern scene.
roles.ground: Create a dense broken terrain-edge wedge with a low heavy mass, one climbing side spur, torn holes, mergeable fractured edges, and grounded material strata. Occupy roughly 40-60% of the canvas while preserving transparent space above and around the formation.
roles.foreground: Create one compact, crisp, deeply shadowed decorative cluster with a narrow vertical or diagonal silhouette, long irregular tips, small overlapping fragments, and generous negative space. Occupy roughly 20-38% of the canvas and keep every outer edge transparent.
